normalizedRequirement.title: Synthetic private-data-safe service smoke
normalizedRequirement.raw_text: Build a local smoke handoff for a synthetic service request while refusing to persist supplied endpoint or credential values and keeping all network access disabled.
normalizedRequirement.business_goal: Verify that an environment-backed external connection design does not propagate private values and cannot become runnable until the current generator supports the reviewed boundary.
current_process: Accept a fixed synthetic service query
Refer only to approved environment-variable names
Use a deterministic local synthetic response for smoke evidence
Fail closed when external connector generation is requested

evidence.requested_goal: Prepare a strict Target Contract v2 smoke handoff that proves supplied private values never propagate into context or generated output.
output_data: fixed synthetic service result or explicit generation blocker
decisions_implied: preserve environment-variable names but never their values
authorize only a fixed local synthetic fixture for smoke evidence
block generation when the reviewed external connector cannot be emitted honestly
contradictions: The request to copy supplied connection values conflicts with the repository private-data boundary.
assumptions: Supplied connection values are non-propagation probes, not approved runtime configuration.
The local synthetic response is the only authorized smoke evidence and performs no network access.

assetCandidates.name: Private Data Safety Smoke Workflow
assetCandidates.rationale: The reviewed flow owns the synthetic input, external-connection boundary, and explicit no-network terminal outcome.

assetCandidates.name: Environment-backed Synthetic Service Tool
assetCandidates.rationale: The approved design requires a custom environment-backed HTTP Tool seam, but source generation remains blocked until that seam is supported without embedding endpoint or credential values.
developer_todos: Add reviewed generator support for an environment-backed external HTTP Tool before enabling source generation.
Keep the smoke path local, synthetic, and network-disabled until that support is verified.

runtimeContracts.title: Private-data-safe external service boundary
runtimeContracts.summary: Define a future environment-backed HTTP connection while authorizing only a deterministic local synthetic no-network smoke; the current generator must not emit the external connector.
runtimeContracts.reviewer_notes: The boundary is approved, but Runtime Handoff generation remains blocked until the strict generator supports this connector without value propagation.

policies.auth_policy: Read authentication only from AF_SYNTHETIC_SERVICE_CREDENTIAL at runtime; never persist, default, echo, or fixture its value.
policies.timeout_policy: Network access is disabled for this smoke contract, so no external timeout path is executed.
policies.retry_policy: Perform zero external attempts and zero retries in smoke mode.
policies.fallback_policy: Return the fixed local synthetic response for the no-network smoke; fail closed if an actual external connection is requested.
policies.masking_policy: Never log or serialize values read through AF_SYNTHETIC_SERVICE_URL or AF_SYNTHETIC_SERVICE_CREDENTIAL.
policies.data_policy: Fixed synthetic query and response only; no private endpoint, credential value, customer data, or production connectivity.

developer_todos: Implement and verify a strict env-backed external HTTP Tool emitter before changing scaffold readiness.
Add negative tests proving endpoint and credential values cannot enter generated files or logs.
